title: XTRA: Cross-Lingual Topic Modeling with Topic and Representation Alignments
subcategory: neural cross-lingual topic model with contrastive alignment
task: Discovering aligned topics across two languages
problem: Cross-lingual topic models improve diversity but struggle with coherence and consistent cross-lingual alignment; dictionary-based alignment suffers from low lexical coverage and topic repetition.
architecture: Shared encoder fed by language-specific MLP projections of BoW inputs; InfoNCE loss aligns document-topic vectors with multilingual PLM embeddings; topic-distribution clustering contrastive alignment uses clusters of multilingual document embeddings as positives/negatives; topic-word distributions are projected into the same semantic space for topic alignment.
llm_or_encoder: Multilingual embeddings (Chen et al., 2024); LLM-based ratings used for evaluation

datasets.name: EC News
datasets.details: English and Chinese news, six categories

datasets.name: Amazon Review
datasets.details: English and Chinese reviews, binary rating label

datasets.name: Rakuten Amazon
datasets.details: Japanese Rakuten and English Amazon reviews, binary label

metrics: Topic Quality TQ = max(0, CNPMI) x TU
intra- and cross-lingual SVM classification accuracy
key_results: EC News: TU 0.993 and TQ 0.075 vs 0.830 and 0.069 for u-SVD; CNPMI 0.076 vs 0.083 for u-SVD.
Amazon Review: CNPMI 0.055, TU 0.980, TQ 0.054; Rakuten Amazon: CNPMI 0.035, TU 0.975, TQ 0.034.
strengths: Produces document-topic posteriors usable for downstream classification, unlike clustering refinements (u-SVD, SVD-LR).
Does not need parallel data or translations for alignment.

limitations.text: Needs a predefined number of topics and clusters.
Relies on pre-trained multilingual embeddings and offline clustering, limiting real-time or dynamic use.
CNPMI on EC News is below the u-SVD baseline.

notes: Older baseline numbers taken from Wu et al. (2023a) as reported in the paper.
